Description

The engine radiator cooling system consists of a fan which operates at two different speeds:

  • the first speed is activated at a first coolant temperature level;
  • the second speed cuts in at a higher temperature threshold.

The fan is operated by means of two special relays located in the relay and fuse box in the engine compartment.

The fan supply line is protected by a special maxifuse, located next to the above mentioned box, whilst the circuit for energizing the relays is protected by a fuse which protects numerous other services controlled by the ignition.

The fan therefore only comes on when the ignition is switched ON.
